data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Spotify App Remote SDK and Web Playback SDK integration.
data.what_it_does: Wraps native iOS and Android Spotify Remote SDKs and the Web Playback SDK. Allows connecting to Spotify, controlling playback, fetching user libraries, and managing authentication tokens or authorization swap flows.
use_when: Building a Flutter app that requires remote control of the official Spotify app on Android or iOS.
Integrating the Spotify Web Playback SDK for browser-based playback.
avoid_when: Playing arbitrary local or remote audio streams without using Spotify.
Running on platforms other than Android, iOS, and Web.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Provides strongly-typed domain exceptions extending SpotifyException.
Handles automatic Gradle resolution of Android SDK binaries.
weaknesses: Requires users to have Spotify Premium for certain SDK features like the Web Playback SDK.
Native platform setups require manual redirect URI configurations and Spotify Developer Portal app registration.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering your app in the Spotify Developer Portal, configuring redirect URIs, and setting up the RedirectUriReceiverActivity in AndroidManifest.xml for Android and Bundle ID/Redirect URI for iOS.
